events.text: An inn cook quits in the middle of dinner rush. The innkeeper looks at you with desperate eyes.

effects.log: Nobody dies. Some even return. (+4 taels)
A mountain of bowls. A free dinner.

events.text: A child tries to pick your pocket and fails badly.

effects.log: The child eats like a wolf and tells you everything about the street.

choices.text: Teach the child a better trade

effects.log: A week of carrying water for a baker. The child stays.

events.text: A letter arrives for someone with a similar name. It is a love letter.

choices.text: Deliver it to the right person

effects.log: Two people are very happy. One is very embarrassed.

choices.text: Return it to the post house

effects.log: Proper. Boring. Correct.

events.text: A ruffian has set up a toll on a public bridge.

ok.log: He runs. The villagers throw a feast.

fail.log: He is tougher than he looks.

effects.log: The magistrate removes him a week later. (−1 taels)

events.text: You start a small herb garden behind your house.

effects.log: Ginger, mint, and something the old women swear by.
The bees are delighted.

events.text: Your neighbour accuses you of stealing a chicken. The chicken is in your yard, eating your rice.

choices.text: Return the chicken with a bag of rice

effects.log: Peace restored. The chicken keeps visiting.
A long, loud argument. The chicken leaves on its own.

events.text: A small merchant cannot afford guards and asks you to walk with him to the next town.

effects.log: A quiet road. He gives you a jar of honey.
A fair deal and a safe road. (+6 taels)

events.text: A fever keeps you in bed for a week.

effects.log: You recover slowly.
You recover faster and weaker.

events.text: A rich man's private library is open to visitors for one day a year.

effects.log: Old battles, old lessons.
You leave humming verses.

events.text: The town gossip says you are secretly the child of an emperor.

effects.log: Nobody believes the denial.
The rumour doubles.

events.text: The ferry is overloaded and taking on water.

ok.log: You bail until you reach shore. Everyone cheers.

fail.log: It sinks in the shallows. Everyone wades out, laughing.

effects.log: The merchant screams. The ferry floats.

events.text: A mountain hermitage offers bed and board in return for a month of work.

effects.log: Chopping wood, carrying water, sitting still.
A good night and a good breakfast.

events.text: You try ink painting. Your bamboo looks like grass. Your grass looks like bamboo.

effects.log: By the end of the year your bamboo looks like bamboo.
An art dealer buys it. (+3 taels)

events.text: A village wrestling match. The champion is a blacksmith with arms like tree trunks.

ok.log: You throw him. He laughs and buys you dumplings.

fail.log: He throws you into a hay cart.

effects.log: He wins. He always wins.

events.text: A man who owes you money pretends not to know you.

effects.log: He finds you a month later and pays half, ashamed.
He pays. He also hates you now.

events.text: The temple bell rings at midnight for no reason.

effects.log: An owl, tangled in the rope.
The bell stops. You sleep well.

events.text: The merchant guild offers you a place guarding their warehouse at night.

effects.log: Quiet nights and good pay. (+12 taels)
Your nights stay your own.

events.text: A lost dog follows you home.

effects.log: A crying child and a grateful mother.

choices.text: Feed it until someone claims it

effects.log: Nobody does. It sleeps by your door.

events.text: A storyteller in the market is telling a story about you. It is mostly wrong.

effects.log: He rewrites it. It gets worse.
You were very brave in this version.

events.text: The price of medicine has doubled. The poor quarter cannot afford it.

effects.log: A merchant is hoarding. You make him stop.
Your cupboard is empty. Many are healthy.

events.text: New neighbours move in next door with six children and three goats.

effects.log: Six children love you immediately. The goats less so.
The goats climb it.

events.text: The public bath house is warm and full of gossip.

effects.log: You learn three secrets and lose all your aches.
A strong old woman beats your back into shape. (−2 taels)

events.text: The town organises a fire bucket brigade and needs strong arms.

effects.log: When a fire comes, you are ready.
The brigade becomes the fastest in the county.

events.text: A scribe needs help copying documents for a week.

effects.log: Your handwriting improves. (+5 taels)
The student gets the work and a start in life.

events.text: A street performer balances plates on sticks. One falls toward a child.

ok.log: You catch it. The crowd thinks it is part of the act.

fail.log: It shatters. The child is fine.

effects.log: Safe, and the plate breaks harmlessly.

events.text: An old bandit runs a noodle shop now. He was once the terror of these hills.

effects.log: He tells you where the bandits hid everything. None of it is still there.
The best noodles in the province. Crime's loss.

events.text: The farmers argue whether it will rain tomorrow. They ask your opinion.

effects.log: You are right. The farmers are impressed.

choices.text: Say what they want to hear

effects.log: It does not rain. They are unimpressed.

events.text: The imperial exams are this month. Every inn is full of nervous scholars.

effects.log: He passes. He sends a letter of thanks.
Nervous scholars drink a lot of tea. (+5 taels)

events.text: A saddled horse with no rider wanders into town.

effects.log: A wounded courier on the road. You save his life and his message.
The stablemaster finds the owner.

events.text: After the flood, the village must rebuild its bridge.

effects.log: A month of work. Your name is carved on the new bridge.
The bridge is finished sooner. (−10 taels)

events.text: The beggars of the city have a king. He asks for an audience with you.

effects.log: He offers you information for silver. Useful. (−3 taels)
The beggars remember kindness.

events.text: The town matchmaker has a list of suitable matches for you. It is very long.

effects.log: Some are promising. Some are very old.
She is faster than she looks.

events.text: In a pawnshop you spot a fine sword for a low price.

ok.log: A real blade, cheaply sold. You buy it. (−8 taels)

fail.log: The edge is painted on. You leave.

effects.log: Fine swords are rarely cheap.

events.text: You shelter from rain under a tree with a stranger who has the same umbrella as you.

effects.log: A fine hour. You never learn their name.
Dried plums for dried meat. A fair trade.

events.text: A wine maker invites you to the pressing of this year's grapes.

effects.log: The grapes are excellent. You buy a jar of wine for your guests. (−3 taels)
Purple feet and a free jar.

events.text: An old soldier sits outside the barracks telling stories of battles long ago.

effects.log: Tactics from before you were born.
He remembers your face and your kindness.

events.text: An herbalist needs rare moss from a cliff face.

ok.log: You bring back a basketful. (+8 taels)

fail.log: You slip and scrape your arms.

choices.text: Point her to a better cliff

effects.log: An easy climb, the same moss.

events.text: The town needs one more person to carry the paper dragon in the parade.

effects.log: You spin, leap, and fall over twice.
The most important job. Your arms ache for a week.

events.text: A silk merchant is being cheated by his own clerk.

effects.log: He fires the clerk and rewards you. (+8 taels)
The clerk returns the money quietly.

events.text: The town is dirty after the festival and nobody wants to clean.

effects.log: By noon, the whole street is sweeping with you.

choices.text: Pay some children to do it

effects.log: Clean streets and happy children. (−2 taels)
